articles.title: Eucalyptus House / Julia Yako + Laura Marino
english: Completed in 2024, the Eucalyptus House is located in Martínez, Argentina. This contemporary residence showcases a harmonious blend with its natural surroundings, taking advantage of its proximity to the Río de la Plata.

The house's design highlights modern architectural elements while maintaining respect for the local environment. Large windows provide ample natural light and facilitate connections with the outdoors.
Julia Yako and Laura Marino aimed to create a peaceful retreat for its inhabitants, focusing on sustainable practices and thoughtful material choices.
chinese: 於2024年完工的尤加利樹屋位於阿根廷的馬丁內斯。這座現代住宅展現了與自然環境的和諧融合，充分利用靠近拉普拉塔河的地理優勢。
這座房屋的設計突顯了現代建築元素，同時又尊重當地環境。大窗戶提供充足的自然光，並促進室內外的連接。
朱莉亞·雅科與勞拉·馬里諾的目標是為居住者創造一個平靜的避風港，專注於可持續的實踐和深思熟慮的材料選擇。

articles.title: Flower-covered theatre forms centrepiece of Denise Scott Brown's photography exhibition
english: A flower-covered theatre has become the centerpiece of an exhibition dedicated to the work of architect Denise Scott Brown. Housed within the striking brutalist architecture school designed by Paul Rudolph, this exhibit highlights her influential photographs from the early years of her career. The exhibition, titled "Encounters: Denise Scott Brown Photographs," aims to provide a fresh perspective on her work, often using it as a lens through which visitors can engage with broader themes of architecture and design.

The exhibition features a custom-built, circular theatre adorned with reflective flower shapes, showcasing Scott Brown's photographs in a unique format. Projectors display her images on 35-millimeter slides, creating an immersive experience that contrasts with the rigid lines of the brutalist space. Curator Izzy Kornblatt explained that the design aims to spark critical conversations about 20th-century architecture and its legacy.

Additionally, the exhibit encourages visitors to explore the thematic connections in Scott Brown's work through five surrounding display spaces. These areas allow for a nonlinear journey, prompting deeper reflections on the photographs and their societal implications. Kornblatt hopes attendees will engage with the material in a way that reshapes their understanding of the architectural environment and their personal experiences within it.
chinese: 一個花朵覆蓋的劇院已成為專為建築師丹尼斯•史考特•布朗（Denise Scott Brown）工作而設的展覽的中心。在保羅•魯道夫（Paul Rudolph）設計的引人注目的粗獷建築學校內，此展覽突出她職業早期的影響力攝影作品。展覽名為《邂逅：丹尼斯•史考特•布朗攝影展》，旨在提供一種全新的視角，通過她的作品讓參觀者關注更廣泛的建築與設計主題。
展覽的特色是定製的圓形劇院，裝飾著反光的花形圖案，獨特地展示史考特•布朗的攝影作品。投影儀以35毫米幻燈片格式展示她的圖片，創造出與粗獷空間的剛性線條形成對比的沉浸式體驗。策展人伊茲•科恩布拉特（Izzy Kornblatt）解釋了該設計旨在激發關於二十世紀建築及其遺產的關鍵對話。
此外，展覽還鼓勵參觀者通過周圍的五個展示空間，探索史考特•布朗作品中的主題聯繫。這些區域使參觀者能夠進行非線性的旅程，促使他們對攝影作品及其社會意義進行更深入的思考。科恩布拉特希望與會者能夠以重塑對建築環境和自身經歷的理解的方式來接觸這些材料。

articles.title: curved wood, rattan, and macaron displays frame a tropical french pâtisserie in singapore
english: The Pierre Hermé Paris flagship store in Singapore, designed by CCD, showcases a distinctive blend of French pastry culture and Singapore's tropical environment. This unique spatial experience is created through careful attention to design elements that foster dialogue between tradition and local context, avoiding a mere replication of the Paris boutique.

Incorporating curved displays and natural materials, the interior reflects a harmony of textures, emphasizing the refined appearance of the pastries. The layout promotes flow and interaction, as curved counters guide customers through the space, presenting a variety of products like macarons and cakes in an engaging manner.

The second floor enhances the experience by merging dining and retail in a climate-responsive environment. Custom rattan seating and warm lighting amplify the connection to Singapore, creating a layered atmosphere where both daylight and artificial lighting collaborate to define a cohesive interior.
chinese: 位於新加坡的皮埃爾·赫米（Pierre Hermé）巴黎旗艦店由CCD設計，展示了法國糕點文化和新加坡熱帶環境的獨特融合。這種獨特的空間體驗通過仔細關注設計元素，促進了傳統與地方背景之間的對話，避免了僅僅重複巴黎精品店的做法。
內部融入了曲線展示和自然材料，反映出質地的和諧，突出了糕點的精緻外觀。平面布置促進了流動和互動，曲線櫃檯引導顧客穿梭於空間，吸引他們欣賞各類產品，如馬卡龍和蛋糕，增添了參與感。
二樓通過將用餐和零售相結合，進一步提升了體驗，並響應氣候的環境。定制的藤編座椅和溫暖的照明增強了與新加坡的聯繫，創造出一種層次感的氛圍，使自然光和人造照明共同作用，定義出一個統一的內部空間。
